Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

openlineage (development version)

  • New ColumnLineageDatasetFacet(), with ColumnLineageInputField() and ColumnLineageTransformation(), for column-level lineage (facet schema 1-2-0). Output matches the OpenLineage Python client (#16).

  • New OpenLineageClient$close(), which closes the client’s transport (#47).

  • HttpTransport no longer follows redirects. A 3xx response raises an openlineage_http_error carrying its status_code, instead of resending the event without its body, or a credential header to another host (#21).

  • Numbers are serialized without loss: integer-valued doubles up to 2^53 exactly, other doubles with the fewest digits that read back as the same value, as the Python client does. Integer fields reject values above 2^53 (#22).

  • new_event_time() no longer emits one millisecond low for about half of all times, and raises an openlineage_validation_error outside the years 0001 to 9999 (#23, #50).

  • Condition messages show user-supplied text, such as column names with braces, literally instead of interpolating it (#24).

  • Assigning a property with @<- runs the same checks as the constructor and raises openlineage_validation_error: dataset roles in RunEvent@inputs and @outputs, the tag field restriction, and ColumnLineageDatasetFacet@fields. x@facets <- list() is accepted and written as {}, and event@event_type <- "COMPLETE" converts the string to a RunState (#25).

  • HTTP transport failures keep their cause: a response with an unreadable or date-valued Retry-After is retried with back-off instead of failing, without a warning, and a connection failure carries the curl error, with no credentials, as parent (#26, #49).

  • HttpTransport$new() checks that timeout is between 0.001 and 2147483 seconds (#27), and rejects a url or endpoint with a query or fragment marker, whitespace, control characters, or . and .. segments, also when percent-encoded (#28).

  • ol_facet() takes schema_url after ..., so a field such as schema is no longer matched to it partially. Positional use is unchanged (#29).

  • Values in ol_facet() that jsonlite would change silently now raise an openlineage_validation_error: infinite numbers, complex and raw vectors, named atomic vectors, lists with repeated or empty names, and other classed objects. POSIXct values are written as event times. The mapping is documented in ?ol_facet (#30, #51).

  • Strings that are not valid UTF-8 are rejected before serialization (#31).

  • Passing transport together with HTTP arguments is an error also when the client is disabled (#34).

  • Input and output statistics counts must be non-negative (#46).

  • ?HttpTransport documents the retry delays and that delivery is at least once (#48).
